description: Read-only MCP server for Calibre-Web: library search, browsing and covers via the OPDS feed
name: io.github.ni-c/calibreweb-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Root URL of the Calibre-Web instance, e.g. https://books.example.com
environmentVariables.name: CALIBRE_WEB_URL

environmentVariables.description: Username of the Calibre-Web account (web login); leave unset together with the password for anonymous-browsing instances
environmentVariables.name: CALIBRE_WEB_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Password of that account (web login password)
environmentVariables.name: CALIBRE_WEB_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed certificates (scoped to the configured host)
environmentVariables.name: CALIBRE_WEB_INSECURE_TLS

title: Calibre-Web
